pages.label: Using the lists
pages.text:
Lookup Lists keeps the lists of values that several applications share (countries, priorities, statuses) as data, so they change without changing an application.

To use a list in another application of the workspace, let that application's database role read the values (once, in SQL Commands or a migration script):

grant usage on schema lookup_lists to app_my_app;
grant select on lookup_lists.list, lookup_lists.list_value to app_my_app;

Then give an item or a grid column a list of values like this one:

select v.display, v.code from lookup_lists.list_value v join lookup_lists.list l on l.id = v.list_id where l.name = 'PRIORITIES' and coalesce(v.active, true) order by v.seq, v.display

or make it a shared list of values (Shared Components, Lists of values) and use LOV:PRIORITIES everywhere.
